description: Retail bank checking account statement with sectioned transaction ledgers, per-section totals, and a daily ending balance grid.
provenance: Modeled on a large US retail bank (Chase/Wells Fargo style) monthly consumer checking statement. Exercises many dense numeric transaction rows split across five categorized sections with computed per-section totals that reconcile to an account summary, zebra striping, repeated table headers across a page break, a multi-pair daily balance grid, and fine-print regulatory text with a dynamic footer and page numbers.
